responsibility: Implements generic substitution application across TyTy nodes. It provides user-facing substitution from explicit HIR generic arguments or inferred arguments, internal substitution from precomputed SubstitutionArgumentMappings, reconstruction of one instantiated type shape onto another, and extraction of the substitution arguments already used by a concrete ADT/function/closure type, while inserting newly materialized implicit types back into TypeCheckContext.
same_name_distinction: Contains the operational substitution visitors for this stem, including traversal over concrete TyTy kinds, context insertion of instantiated types, and extraction/reapplication of used substitution arguments; the header only declares those mapper classes.
